verses.greek: Ὃ ἦν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, ὃ ἀκηκόαμεν, ὃ ἑωράκαμεν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς ἡμῶν, ὃ ἐθεασάμεθα καὶ αἱ χεῖρες ἡμῶν ἐψηλάφησαν, περὶ τοῦ λόγου τῆς ζωῆς—
verses.literal: That which was from the beginning that which we have heard that which we have seen with the eyes of us that which we have gazed upon and the hands of us handled concerning the Word the of life —
verses.dgt: What was from the beginning, what we have heard, what we have seen with our eyes, what we looked upon and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life—

verses.greek: καὶ ἡ ζωὴ ἐφανερώθη, καὶ ἑωράκαμεν καὶ μαρτυροῦμεν καὶ ἀπαγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν τὴν ζωὴν τὴν αἰώνιον ἥτις ἦν πρὸς τὸν πατέρα καὶ ἐφανερώθη ἡμῖν—
verses.literal: and the life was made manifest and we have seen and bear witness and we proclaim to you the life the eternal which was with the Father and was revealed to us —
verses.dgt: and the life was revealed, and we have seen it and testify and announce to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us—

verses.greek: ὃ ἑωράκαμεν καὶ ἀκηκόαμεν ἀπαγγέλλομεν καὶ ὑμῖν, ἵνα καὶ ὑμεῖς κοινωνίαν ἔχητε μεθʼ ἡμῶν· καὶ ἡ κοινωνία δὲ ἡ ἡμετέρα μετὰ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ μετὰ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ·
verses.literal: that which we have seen and have heard we proclaim also to you so that also you yourselves fellowship may have with us Indeed the fellowship now the our own is with the Father and with the Son of Him Jesus Christ.
verses.dgt: what we have seen and heard we announce also to you, so that you too may have fellowship with us; and indeed our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.

verses.greek: καὶ ταῦτα γράφομεν ἡμεῖς ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ἡμῶν ᾖ πεπληρωμένη.
verses.literal: And these things write we ourselves so that the joy of us may be completed.
verses.dgt: And we write these things so that our joy may be made complete.

verses.greek: Καὶ ἔστιν αὕτη ἡ ἀγγελία ἣν ἀκηκόαμεν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀναγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν, ὅτι ὁ θεὸς φῶς ἐστιν καὶ σκοτία ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν οὐδεμία.
verses.literal: And is this the message that we have heard from Him and we preach to you that the God light is and darkness in Him not is none.
verses.dgt: And this is the message we have heard from him and announce to you: God is light, and there is no darkness in him at all.

verses.greek: ἐὰν εἴπωμεν ὅτι κοινωνίαν ἔχομεν μετʼ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ σκότει περιπατῶμεν, ψευδόμεθα καὶ οὐ ποιοῦμεν τὴν ἀλήθειαν·
verses.literal: If we shall say that fellowship we have with Him and yet in the darkness may walk we lie and not we do practice the truth
verses.dgt: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.

verses.greek: ἐὰν δὲ ἐν τῷ φωτὶ περιπατῶμεν ὡς αὐτός ἐστιν ἐν τῷ φωτί, κοινωνίαν ἔχομεν μετʼ ἀλλήλων καὶ τὸ αἷμα Ἰησοῦ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ καθαρίζει ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης ἁμαρτίας.
verses.literal: If now in the light we shall walk as He himself is in the light fellowship we have with one another and the blood of Jesus the Son of Him cleanses us from all sin.
verses.dgt: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanses us from every sin.

verses.greek: ἐὰν εἴπωμεν ὅτι ἁμαρτίαν οὐκ ἔχομεν, ἑαυτοὺς πλανῶμεν καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν ἡμῖν.
verses.literal: If we shall say that sin not we have ourselves we deceive and the truth not is in us.
verses.dgt: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

verses.greek: ἐὰν ὁμολογῶμεν τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν, πιστός ἐστιν καὶ δίκαιος ἵνα ἀφῇ ἡμῖν τὰς ἁμαρτίας καὶ καθαρίσῃ ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης ἀδικίας.
verses.literal: If we shall confess the sins of us faithful He is and just that He may forgive us the our sins and may cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.dgt: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us our sins and cleanse us from every unrighteousness.

verses.greek: ἐὰν εἴπωμεν ὅτι οὐχ ἡμαρτήκαμεν, ψεύστην ποιοῦμεν αὐτὸν καὶ ὁ λόγος αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν ἡμῖν.
verses.literal: If we shall say that not we have sinned a liar we make Him and the word of Him not is in us.
verses.dgt: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
